  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (uuidv7()) NOT NULL,
  "is_builtin" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "label" text NOT NULL,
  "language" text NOT NULL,
  "synonyms" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
